propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock time assertions in tests are a proven source of CI flake under runner contention; 13 sites currently unescaped across the test suite.

Detector must block new unescaped upper-bound assertions via regex scanning with two escape mechanisms: reasoned hang-guard marker comment and skipif-CI perf-lane guard (bare @pytest.mark.benchmark does not escape).

Two specific test sites must migrate to counting-proxy assertions: test_config_perf.py:201 spying config._ordered_layers cache hits, and test_enrich_drain.py:261 counting pending_enrichment probes with zero drain calls.
Remaining 9 in-scope sites receive hang-guard marker annotations with documented reasons; detector self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES prevents own unit test fixtures from triggering the gate.
Detector integrated as CI lint gate step in _build-and-test.yml with unit test coverage for fire cases, both escape mechanisms, and false-negative prevention.
